units.headline: New helper checks series has no OOO data
units.summary: Pulls the existing s.ooo == nil check out into a predicate used by the filters and eviction. It has the same meaning as the inline check it replaces.
units.reason: A trivial predicate pulled out of existing inline logic.

units.headline: Stale-NaN check pulled out into a shared helper
units.summary: Uses the same three-way stale-NaN check that was inline in gcStaleSeries and staleSeriesRefsNoOOOData.
units.reason: Same expression as the removed inline code.

units.headline: Stale truncation adds OOO and appendID watermark guards
units.summary: Stale-series eviction now also needs the series to have no OOO data and no appendID above the watermark. It now goes through the generic truncateSeries.
units.reason: Changes which series are evicted from the head, and eviction is persisted to the WAL.
focus: watermark is captured before the block write in compactHeadViewLocked
the new OOO check changes stale eviction behavior

units.headline: New eviction path for caller-selected series
units.summary: Evicts caller-provided refs that have no OOO data and no late appends. Unlike the stale path, it does not require the series to be stale.
units.reason: New public-facing data eviction path.
focus: with isolation disabled, late appends are lost (the test documents this)

units.headline: Detects samples appended after the compaction watermark
units.summary: Walks the series txRing looking for any appendID above the watermark. This guard is what keeps late samples from being evicted.
units.reason: A safety guard that prevents data loss; whether it is correct depends on txRing semantics.
focus: the txRing iterator starts at txIDFirst and the count is correct
cleanup of old appendIDs cannot drop IDs above the watermark
the caller holds s.Lock

units.headline: Generic truncation that takes a predicate and returns the evicted count
units.summary: Generalizes the old stale truncation to take a shouldEvict predicate and return the deleted count. The lock, reader-wait and WAL tombstone logic are unchanged.
units.reason: Core eviction path that also writes WAL tombstones.
focus: tombstones are written only for refs that were actually deleted

units.headline: Test passes a MaxUint64 watermark to the new signature
units.summary: Updates the call to the new signature; MaxUint64 turns the watermark guard off. The assertions are unchanged.
units.reason: Test-only signature update.

units.headline: New test for the filter helper's keep, skip and drop outcomes
units.summary: Checks that a clean series is kept, a series with OOO data is skipped and an unknown ref is dropped.
units.reason: New test only.
